# Legacy save fixture

`v12_payload.bin` was generated by the unmodified v1.2 application serializer.
It is a synthetic 3,568-byte format-1 payload, not user data.

It contains day 3 with flags 1025, expected weight 110.500 kg, actual weight
111.250 kg, and the note `Keep this original note`; XP is 90. Two closed days
are retained. Day 2 has flags 512, actual weight 111.500 kg, and note
`Yesterday from v1.2`.

`migration_test.cpp` wraps these original bytes in A/B envelopes and exercises
the real firmware adapter's mixed-format loading, upgrade and fallback paths.
